text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of code, such as a single function, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests, on the other hand, examine how different parts of a system work together. Many developers also use test-driven development, where they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them think carefully about what the code should do. Good testing gives developers confidence. When tests pass, they know their changes have not broken anything. This confidence allows teams to improve their software faster and with less fear of making mistakes.
